text: Carpentry is the craft of building and maintaining various structures, ranging from simple door and window frames to complex houses. Various techniques are used to achieve desired jointing and finishes, such as screws, glue, and rivets. Varnish is an often-overlooked aspect that adds a protective layer to the finished surface, providing durability and attractiveness. Joints are crucial to the stability and longevity of the structure. Mastering jointing and varnishing techniques allows carpenters to create beautiful and functional spaces that are both safe and durable.
